description: Creates an injectable store class from a list of features. Pass `{ providedIn: 'root' }` first for a global singleton.
Adds state. Each top-level key becomes a read-only signal (`store.key()`); nested objects become deep signals.
Adds methods. The factory receives the store so far and may call `inject()`.
Writes state with partial objects or updater functions `(state) => partial`. Unmentioned keys are kept.
Default since NgRx 18: state can only be patched from inside the store, not from consumers.
Returns a plain snapshot of the store state.
